title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC ETF week (Sep 21-26): $2.39B net inflows — best week of 2026, highest since Jan-2024 launch.
Altcoin season index at 3-month high; 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 rising; NEAR +31% on Bitwise ETF approval.
No price threshold breaches (BTC +0.2%, ETH -0.1%, all others flat).
PCE (Sep 30) + NFP due this week — key inputs for next Fed move.
